services.desc: Everyone comes to Lake Toho expecting alligators. And yes, the gators absolutely deliver. But the moment you step onto an airboat and start gliding across the water, something unexpected happens. You realize the lake is teeming with life in every direction. Lake Toho is one of Florida’s most biodiverse ecosystems. The wildlife here goes far beyond gators. Birds, fish, turtles, and even one of America’s most iconic animals all call this lake home. Knowing what to look for makes your airboat tour a completely different experience. An airboat tour reveals an entire ecosystem working together.
